messages:
Zoe: Quick micro-poll: rooftop mobility flow (20m) at 6:30am vs stairwell ladder sprints (10x up/down) at 6:20am. Optional cooldown coffee+smoothie run after. Who's up? :sunrise:

Marco: Rooftop for me 1 I can lead a short mobility sequence. Rooftop mats? I'll bring two.

Tanya: Stair sprints! Trying to get better vertical power. Can anyone time intervals? :stopwatch:

Raj: Split vote: rooftop mobility then 4x sprint pyramid. Won't climb after but happy to pace. Also FYI stairs are being cleaned earlier so we might need to go to the north stairwell.

Zoe: React with :person_in_lotus_position: = rooftop, :dash: = stairs, :tropical_drink: = staying for smoothie/coffee. I'll check rooftop availability (security) and post final plan.

Marco: :person_in_lotus_position: :tropical_drink: (will bring extra mat + a small foam roller)

Tanya: :dash: 

Raj: :dash: :tropical_drink:

wellness-bot: Notice: Rooftop access requires a brief safety check with facilities. Automated: allow 24h notice for groups >4.

Zoe: Thanks bot. Looks mixed 1 we can do a hybrid: meet 6:20 north stairwell for warmup, quick sprint set (6:25-6:40), then head up to rooftop for mobility flow and cooldown (starts ~6:50). Smoothie run at 7:10 if people want. Sound ok?

Marco: Works for me. I'll bring mats to rooftop and a small Bluetooth speaker for cues.

Tanya: Can someone record 1 sprint for form critique? I'll share on the climbing channel later.

Raj: I can film. Also, anyone up for 10 pull-ups after sprints? :muscle:

Zoe: Haha optional pull-ups. Final check: who needs a mat or stair-grip gloves? Call it out now.

Marco: Mat secured. No gloves.

Tanya: No mat. Borrow gloves if available.

Raj: Mat ok. See you 6:15 in lobby for coffee and jog to north stairs. :coffee:
